decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a hot food take-away shall not be open for customers outside the following times 11.00 to 23.00 Mondays to Saturdays and 11.00 to 22.00 on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until full details of a scheme for control of fumes and odours (extract flue shown on drawing 03-01-02) has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, anti-vibration mounting, design, materials, colour and position and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the takeaway shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use from travel agent (A1) to fast food takeaway (A5) incorporating the retention of existing single-storey rear extension and the erection of an extract flue on the first floor rear elevation.
